summary_zh: 一组面向智能体的界面构建技能，涵盖UI打磨、排版、配色、无障碍、布局、产品文案与界面评审，还提供从设计稿构建界面、拆解组件状态、生成变体、压力测试和解释网页实现等工具。
audience_zh: 适合前端与设计工程师、UI/UX设计师，以及使用Claude Code等智能体进行界面开发、评审和优化，需要系统化检查无障碍、排版、色彩与布局的人群。

evidence.quote: A collection of agent skills that help you build great interfaces.
A collection of agent skills that cover UI, typography, colors, accessibility, layout, product writing and help you build a great interface.

- [**better-interface**](skills/better-interface/SKILL.md): Reviews a screen, flow or whole interface across **accessibility**, **layout**, **writing**, **typography**, **color** and **UI polish**, and returns one ranked report.

- [**better-accessibility**](skills/better-accessibility/SKILL.md): Reviews and fixes **keyboard and focus behavior**, **ARIA**, **accessible names**, **forms**, **screen-reader announcements**, **motion** and **zoom** against WCAG 2.2.
